headline: SEC Announces Roundtable on Machine-Understandable Data and Super Intelligence
summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission announced it will host a November 2026 roundtable to discuss machine-understandable data, Super Intelligence, and associated market risks.
why: The SEC is the chief regulatory body responsible for protecting investors and maintaining fair, orderly markets in the United States.

impacts.name: Financial Regulation & Technology
impacts.why: Regulatory forums on artificial intelligence and data standards signal future reporting and compliance rules for public firms.
